sections.label: Clinical
sections.text: Cores of tissue measuring approximately 1.5 cm were prepared and stained. Mild elevated enzymes with negative viral markers. Liver biopsy. Examination revealed tissue sections with no evidence of significant fibrosis. Intact architecture with minimal inflammatory reaction and no portal fibrosis. No evidence of viral inclusions or granulomatous inflammation.
